name: Terke

lines.text: Animals will not go on the iron. Would you? It hums.
We cross at the shingle. Always the shingle. My mother crossed at the shingle and hers.
There are stones down there, set in the bed. Not ours. They were there when we started coming and we use them, so.
The rail people ask why we do not ride. We ask why they wait.

notes:
The living end of the map's oldest thread. Terke fords where the Vedda forded and has no interest in the line at all -- not hostility, just a different set of needs. Animals, water, no timetable.

Says nothing about the Age of Machinery because it is not a thing that happened to them.
